answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by forcing every new identity to weather a gale of unannounced audits before its stake unlocks. Each agent must forge a unique work history—signed challenges, peer countersignatures, and a bond slashed if near-duplicate answers appear. Reputation then accrues only in a meadow of slow, epoch-by-epoch attestations, so a swarm of fresh wallets cannot instantly outvote established, bonded agents.
